K.Sakthivel vs The Commissioner on 12 September, 2024 
 W.P.No.2995
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras
 Dated: 12.09.2024
 Coram:
 The Honourable Mr.Justice G.Arul Murugan
 W.P.No.29954 of 2014
 and
 M.P.No.01 of 2014 
 K.Sakthivel .... Pet
 Vs
 The Commissioner,
 Tamil Nadu Food Safety and Drugs Administration Department,
 No.359, Anna Salai, Dms Campus,
 Tyenampet,
 Chennai  600 006 ....Respondent 
 Prayer :  Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of Constitution of In  pleased to issue a Writ of Certiorarified Mandamus to call for the rec  relating to the impugned proceedings issued by the Respondent in  R.No.7770/2014/S1/FSSA dated 09.10.2014 and to quash the same and  consequently direct the Respondent to consider the petitioner for tran  the vacant post of Food Safety Officer in Coimbatore Corporation purel  based on medical grounds as considered in similar cases.
 For Petitioner : Mr. S.Nedunchezhiyan  For Respondents : Mr.Stalin Abimanyu  Additional Government Pleader  ________ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis  Page 1 of 4  W.P.No.29  ORDER The Writ Petition has been filed challenging the impugned proceedings issued by the Respondent in R.No.7770/2014/S1/FSSA dated 09.10.2014 and consequently direct the Respondent to consider K.Sakthivel vs The Commissioner on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145623044/ 
1 the petitioner for transfer to the vacant post of Food Safety Officer in Coimbatore Corporation. 
2. When the matter is taken up for hearing, the learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that nothing survives in this petition and he has also made an endorsement in the petition to that effect. 
3. In view of the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner that nothing survives in this petition, this Writ Petition is dismissed as infructuous. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed. No costs.
